Custom window treatments. Personal service.

The showroom comes
to your living room.

See fabrics and finishes beside your furniture, in your own light. David Fear brings samples to you and helps you compare styles, privacy options, and controls that suit each room.

From a single window to a whole home, you’ll get practical guidance, professional measurements, and a quote without pressure.

Get My Free Consultation

Made for the way you live.

The light you want.

Soften bright sun, reduce glare, or bring more privacy to your evenings. Choose the right fabric and light control for each room.

The style that feels like home.

Compare shades, blinds, and shutters in colors and textures that work with your home, from clean roller shades to tailored Roman shades.

The details, handled.

We measure your windows and install your custom treatments. Before we leave, we’ll show you how to use and care for them.

Motorized shades for everyday ease

On your schedule.
At the touch of a button.

Open your shades to morning light and close them for evening privacy. A remote puts control within reach, even for tall windows or a room full of shades.

With a compatible system, you can add app control, schedules, or voice commands. David will help you compare battery-powered and hardwired options and explain what works with your home.
